_meta.status: COMPLETE - all 12 fields x 12 leases recorded by hand from the source documents (2026-09-09). No values were guessed. Where a lease defines the commencement/expiration by a construction milestone rather than a calendar date, the value is prefixed 'derived:' and states what the document actually says. null = the lease does not address that field (the correct extraction result is 'not found').
_meta.rent_rolls_note: The 3 rent rolls are FABRICATED for the demo -- a rent roll is a property-management-system export, synthesized here from the real lease terms in this file. Each carries deliberately planted lease-vs-rent-roll disagreements (see planted_disagreements) plus one phantom vacant unit, so the reconciliation flow has something to catch.
